name: wave_function_collapse
tagline: Maxim Gumin's WFC — constraint-propagation procedural generation. Each cell is a superposition of tiles; collapse the lowest-entropy cell, propagate adjacency, cascade, repeat.
architecture_note: Algorithm repo with a display layer, not a per-pixel shader. The solver is the brain (CPU); the GPU is the eye (display only).
run: open index.html — no build step, no server
pipeline: wfc-solver.js runs the collapse -> tile-index grid
tile renderer draws tiles from a procedural atlas by index
entropy heatmap renders live superposition uncertainty during solving
